prelaunch_updates.text: OPEN CAMPAIGN: Axis Robotics Season 2 now pays AXIS directly. From Sat 11/14 every verified, signed task (trajectory) earns 1 to 2.5 AXIS depending on difficulty, up to 5 runs per task; practice and 1-star tasks pay 0. Rewards settle every Saturday 10:00 UTC and are claimed to a Base wallet; unclaimed AXIS never expires. Referrals and multipliers removed. Join at hub.axisrobotics.ai. Unconfirmed: whether signing a task needs a wallet signature. No end date announced.
OPEN CAMPAIGN: TermiX x Four Meme x MonoPoly social bounty: follow @fourdotmemezh, @0x_mpmarket and @termix_ai, submit proof on agent.family, get 0.2 USDT + 50 TP once verified. No end date given.

Arthur Hayes published a FLOP mining revenue model (flop.finance/intro/revenue) and said any hardware can mine; income depends on agent demand for the models it can run. Testnet and airdrop still Tue 11/24 (tentative). No token exists.

Flop Labs and founder Arthur Hayes: testnet and airdrop begin Tue 11/24 (tentative; changes to be announced in advance). Hayes says consumer GPUs and Mac Minis should be able to mine. Not joinable yet, no token or contract; any FLOP token is a scam.
TermiX's game-creation agent (powered by Claude Fable 5.2) is live on agent.family: describe a game in one sentence and it builds it. No new points or token terms.
GenLayer teaser: AI agents will need a judge for disputes, 'GEN will power every verdict. Coming Soon.' No date, contract or venue. Any GEN token now is a scam.
Arthur Hayes: Flop's spot compute market 'is just beginning'; the aim is to let retail consumer GPUs serve the agentic economy. Still no testnet date and no FLOP token.
Quip launched a unified app: accounts, swaps (order book) and points in one place. No TGE date or token yet; any QUIP token is a scam.

GenLayer explained node seats: at mainnet the Foundation backs validators with its own GEN. Seats are split by Staking Points (1 point per staked GEN per day) from a snapshot shortly before mainnet, and each seat needs a node that has run 30 days on Clarke, the testnet before mainnet. Pre-Mainnet Staking opens on 'THE DAY' (still undated). No token yet; any GEN token now is a scam.
TermiX teased an AI Game Agent 'coming soon' to agent.family (describe a game, the agent builds it). No date and no new points or reward terms.
